例句

  1. It cost ten thousand yen to have this bike repaired.
    修這台腳踏車花了一萬日圓。
  2. It costs 500 yen to get into the museum.
    進博物館要五百日圓。
  3. It cost me 2,000 yen to fix my phone.
    我修手機花了兩千日圓。
  4. This T-shirt cost 1,000 yen.
    這件 T 恤花了一千日圓。
  5. How much does it cost to take a taxi to the airport?
    搭計程車去機場要多少錢？
  6. It costs a lot of money to keep a big dog.
    養一隻大狗要花很多錢。
  7. It cost us 30,000 yen to stay at the hotel for two nights.
    我們在飯店住兩晚花了三萬日圓。
  8. The concert tickets cost 8,000 yen each.
    演唱會門票每張八千日圓。
  9. It doesn't cost anything to use the library.
    用圖書館不用花錢。
  10. I had my hair cut yesterday.
    我昨天去剪了頭髮。
  11. We need to have the car checked.
    我們需要把車拿去檢查。
  12. She got her watch fixed.
    她把手錶拿去修好了。
  13. Where did you have your photo taken?
    你的照片是在哪裡請人拍的？
  14. I'm going to have my eyes tested tomorrow.
    我明天要去檢查眼睛。
  15. My father had the roof painted last month.
    我爸爸上個月請人油漆了屋頂。
  16. You should have your teeth checked twice a year.
    你應該一年檢查牙齒兩次。
  17. I got my bike repaired at the shop near the station.
    我把腳踏車拿去車站附近的店修好了。
  18. Ann had her dress made by her aunt.
    Ann 請她阿姨幫她做洋裝。
  19. We had a pizza delivered to our room.
    我們叫了披薩送到房間。
  20. How much did it cost to have your computer repaired?
    把你的電腦拿去修花了多少錢？
  21. It cost 3,000 yen to have my shoes fixed.
    把我的鞋拿去修花了三千日圓。
  22. It will cost a lot to have the house cleaned.
    請人打掃房子會花很多錢。
  23. I want to have this picture framed.
    我想把這張畫拿去裱框。
  24. My mother gets her hair cut every month.
    我媽媽每個月去剪頭髮。
  25. It cost Tom 5,000 yen to have his bike painted.
    Tom 把他的腳踏車拿去烤漆花了五千日圓。
  26. It costs 200 yen to take the bus to the station.
    搭公車到車站要兩百日圓。
  27. Did you get your passport renewed?
    你的護照換新了嗎？
  28. It cost me a lot to have my phone screen fixed.
    我把手機螢幕拿去修花了很多錢。
  29. We had our photo taken in front of Tokyo Tower.
    我們請人在東京鐵塔前幫我們拍了照片。
  30. This dictionary cost 4,000 yen, but it is very useful.
    這本字典花了四千日圓，可是很有用。
